verdict.rationale: Airweave is not itself an agent but a data-integration/search platform, so the MCP-server axis applies; docs explicitly describe an official MCP server implementing the Model Context Protocol so AI assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude) can search synced data, corroborated by a probe confirming the docs page and community feedback praising its integration with Cursor. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's setup/connection process beyond docs and a single community mention, and no detail on protocol compliance testing.
